title: TopologyRelationshipSourceRequirements
description: Planner-facing source contract for a relationship. It advertises whether a source is needed and which source forms topology-service can accept without exposing graph internals.

required.description: Whether the relationship needs a caller-supplied source beyond the active view binding.

acceptedForms.description: Source forms supported by topology-service for this relationship in the current context.

selectionKinds.description: Concrete topology graph element kinds that are meaningful when acceptedForms includes sourceSelection.

description.description: Short human-readable source guidance for planner context and diagnostics.
